title: nail and libnail list dependencies they do not use
body:
No file in nail/src names `strum_macros`, `indexmap` or `colored`, yet nail/Cargo.toml lists all three as dependencies. libnail/Cargo.toml lists `colored` as a dev-dependency, and no file in libnail/src names it.

## Proposal

Remove the four entries, then build and run `cargo test` to confirm nothing used them through a macro.
close_reason: The four entries are gone from nail/Cargo.toml and libnail/Cargo.toml; both crates build and all 97 tests pass. Committed on dev.
